text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, like sorting emails or processing data, which saves time and reduces errors. At the same time, productivity tools powered by AI help employees plan projects, draft reports, and analyze information more quickly. However, AI does not replace humans entirely. Instead, we see human-AI collaboration, where people use AI as a smart assistant to support decision-making. This shift means some jobs will change or disappear, but new roles will appear, such as AI trainers or ethics specialists. To adapt, workers must focus on skills like creativity, problem-solving, and emotional intelligence.
